reviews.comment:
La atención es regular.una vez un playero cargo el doble de lo que le pidieron supuestamente le dijeron 300 desde adentro del auto con el vidrio alto y entendio 600 q no se sabe si a propósito le dieron la orden q haga ese tipo de cosas pobre muchacho e armaron un escándalo.luego si cargas te preguntan si querés tiket lo cual se sabe q es obligatorio xq el IVA te lo están cobrando Papu.saludos.

(Translated by Google)
The service is so-so. Once, a gas station attendant charged you double what they asked for. They supposedly told him 300 from inside the car with the window rolled up, but he understood 600. It's unclear if he was intentionally instructed to do that. Poor guy, and they made a huge scene. Then, when you fill up, they ask if you want a receipt, which is obviously mandatory because they're charging you VAT. Cheers.
